pages.title: Enchantments
pages.text: Three archery enchantments ship with the mod:$(br2)$(l)Bioluminescence$(): consumes a torch to make the arrow carry light, lighting where it lands.
$(l)Gale Force$(): adds a burst of wind to your shots.$(br2)$(l)Photosynthesis$(): a modular bow slowly repairs itself in daylight under open sky. Requires a wooden riser and non-Nether limbs.
